recognize_zh: 兩個嗜中性球的細胞膜外緣整圈黏附著一顆顆血小板，形成像花環的血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），背景游離血小板很少；血小板被困在白血球周圍，使自動計數機低估血小板（假性血小板減少）。
features: Two segmented neutrophils each rimmed by a ring of adherent platelets (rosettes)
Platelets of normal size and granulation attached to the neutrophil membrane
Few free-lying platelets in the background
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without fragments
No platelet clumps elsewhere in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils surrounded by rosettes of normal-sized, well-granulated platelets adhering to their cell membranes, with relatively few free platelets in the background. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that causes spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts; a repeat platelet count in citrate-anticoagulated blood or from a fingerstick smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free-standing aggregates of platelets rather than rosettes around neutrophils, although the two may coexist.
True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly few platelets without satellitism or clumping, and the count does not correct in citrate.
Phagocytosed material lies within cytoplasmic vacuoles, whereas satellite platelets sit on the outer cell surface.
